# EyeTrackVR Docs

> Official EyeTrackVR documentation: build an open-source, affordable VR eye tracker for VRChat, social VR and PCVR. Works with nearly all headsets.

EyeTrackVR (ETVR) is an open-source, community-built eye tracking platform for VR headsets.
Hardware, firmware and app source are all free. Tracking data is sent over OSC/UDP and never leaves the user's PC.

Site: https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev
Source: https://github.com/EyeTrackVR/EyeTrackVR-Docs
Community: https://discord.gg/kkXYbVykZX

## Overview

- [About the EyeTrackVR Project](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/about): Who builds EyeTrackVR: the team and contributors behind the open-source VR eye tracking project and how it is run.
- [Contact and Community](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/contact): Join the EyeTrackVR Discord for build help, hardware questions and contributing to the open-source VR eye tracking project.

## Development

- [Docs Site Development](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/development/docs/dev_docs): How the EyeTrackVR documentation site is built with VitePress, and how to run and build it locally.
- [Adding and Editing Docs Pages](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/development/docs/pages): How to add, edit and structure pages on the EyeTrackVR docs site, including the frontmatter every page should carry.
- [Docs Standards Guide](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/development/docs/standards): The writing and formatting standards that keep EyeTrackVR documentation consistent and easy to follow.

## Firmware Guide

- [Firmware Overview](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/firmware_guide/firmware): How EyeTrackVR firmware runs on the ESP32, streams camera video over 2.4GHz WiFi or USB, and talks to the desktop app.
- [Flashing Tool Advanced Options](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/firmware_guide/flashing_tool_advanced_options): Advanced options in the EyeTrackVR flashing tool, including manual settings for experienced users and troubleshooting.
- [Firmware Flashing Tool](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/firmware_guide/flashing_tool): How to flash EyeTrackVR firmware with the flashing tool: pick a board, connect over USB or mDNS, and confirm the update.
- [mDNS Tracker Discovery](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/firmware_guide/mdns): How EyeTrackVR uses mDNS to find trackers on your network, what the tracker names mean, and how to fix discovery problems.
- [Firmware REST API](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/firmware_guide/rest_api): The REST API exposed by EyeTrackVR firmware on the ESP32: endpoints, usage, and how the desktop app talks to your tracker.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction and Getting Started](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/getting_started/intro): What EyeTrackVR is, how the open-source VR eye tracking platform sends eye data over OSC, which headsets work, and the six steps to your first build.
- [IR LED Eye Safety](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/getting_started/led_safety): Near-eye infrared safety for EyeTrackVR: ICNIRP and IEC 62471 limits, 850 nm emitter output numbers, and the rules for safe DIY LED kits.

## Headset Guides

- [Valve Index Build Guide](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/headset_guides/valve_index): Two proven ways to build a clean EyeTrackVR setup on the Valve Index, including mounts, camera placement and wiring.
- [Headset Specific Guides](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/headset_guides/what_is_this): What the headset specific guides cover: quirks, recommended 3D printed mounts and setup notes for each VR headset.

## How to Build

- [3D Printed Camera Mounts](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/3d_printed_mounts): Community 3D printed EyeTrackVR camera mounts for Valve Index, Quest, Pico, WMX and more, with the recommended print for each headset.
- [IR LED Kit Setup](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/led_setup): Choose the EyeTrackVR LED guide that matches your hardware: the V4 LED kits or the V5 Pro USB-C development kit.
- [Assembling V4 LED Kits](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/led_v4_setup): How to assemble V4, V4 mini and V4E IR LED boards, wire them up and check polarity before mounting them in your headset.
- [Assembling the V5 Pro LED Kit](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/led_v5_setup): How to assemble the EyeTrackVR V5 Pro LED kit: USB-C mainboard, six V5 LED boards, two V5E end boards and the two-wire cables.
- [Required Parts and BOM](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/part_list): Every part an EyeTrackVR build needs: ESP32 board options, cameras, IR LED kits, cables and 3D printed mounts, with what to buy and where.
- [IR Filter Removal](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/preparing_cameras): How to remove the IR cut filter from EyeTrackVR cameras so the sensors can see the 850 nm illuminators, with step-by-step photos.
- [Preparing the XIAO ESP32 Sense](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/preparing_xiao): What ships in the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32 Sense box and how to prepare the board for an EyeTrackVR eye tracker build.
- [V4 Full Build Guide](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/how_to_build/v4_full_build): Step-by-step assembly of a V4 EyeTrackVR tracker: cameras, IR LEDs, ESP32 and mount, from parts to first calibration.

## Miscellaneous

- [Designing Your Own Camera Mount](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/misc/creating_your_own_mount): How to design your own EyeTrackVR camera mount for a headset that has no community mount yet, with measurement basics.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/misc/faq): Answers about EyeTrackVR: supported headsets, cost, IR eye safety, how the tracking works, and how to get help.
- [Ordering Prints from JLC3DP](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/misc/jlc3dp): How to order EyeTrackVR 3D printed mounts from JLC3DP when you do not own a printer, from upload to shipping.
- [VRChat Avatar Setup for Eye Tracking](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/misc/vrc_avatar_setup): How to set up a VRChat avatar for EyeTrackVR eye tracking, including blend shapes, config and a walkthrough video.

## Software Guide

- [Build the ETVR App from Source](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/software_guide/build_software): How to build the EyeTrackVR app from source, including the toolchain, dependencies and build steps for each platform.
- [Install and Set Up the ETVR App](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/software_guide/eyetrackvr_app_guide): How to download, install and calibrate the EyeTrackVR desktop app, and how to tune tracking for your eyes and lighting.
- [OSC Recenter and Recalibrate in VRChat](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/software_guide/osc_setup): Set up VRChat OSC so you can recenter and recalibrate EyeTrackVR eye tracking from inside the game without touching the app.
- [VRCFT ETVR Tracking Module](https://docs.eyetrackvr.dev/software_guide/VRCFT_tracking_module): How to use the VRCFT EyeTrackVR module to feed eye tracking into VRChat through VRCFT instead of the OSC pathway.
